facts.value: As part of your study program in another department, you can complete certain modules in our Department of Economics, known as export modules of the Department of Economics - including elective modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: For the study programs of other departments, the following overview has compiled which export modules you can enroll in at the Department of Economics and how you can integrate these export modules into your study program in your department.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Furthermore, you cannot integrate other modules from the Department of Economics into your study program in another department and also cannot obtain differing Credit Points (CP) at the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy
